requirements.text: The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms and resource management to minimize energy consumption during data processing operations.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions prioritizing energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow real-time attendance updates with controlled thresholds to minimize energy consumption while ensuring data accuracy.
The system shall provide an option to generate reports in formats that minimize digital resource usage.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall implement robust encryption and access control to protect student attendance data.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement load balancing techniques that optimize resource utilization during attendance processing.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to report unauthorized access or data breaches.
The system shall maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records.
